raw_segments.text: There are many follies, in some degree, peculiar to women, sins against reason, of commission,
as well as of omission, but all flowing from ignorance or prejudice, I shall only point
out such as appear to be injurious to their moral character.
And in animadverting on them, I wish especially to prove that the weakness of mind and body,
which men have endeavored by various motives to perpetuate, prevents their discharging
the peculiar duty of their sex.
For when weakness of body will not permit them to suckle their children, and weakness
of mind makes them spoil their temper's woman in a natural state.
